limitations: Service epochs are calls, not simulation ticks or rest duration.
Low idle cost is a hot isolated callback case, not measured runtime producer cost.
Churn budgets cause different actual scanned work; elapsed totals are not equal-work A/B.
Fixed4096 capacity is retained for every area; no dynamic registry sizing selected.
No connected-region count/area, World hash lookup, mutation hooks, metadata pass, collider or renderer costs.
Submicrosecond recovery timing is at timer/harness scale; retain values without a latency claim.
Seven process repeats preserve ranges/outliers and do not establish hardware portability.
